summary: Verified date-picker bug fix in Studio Gallery 'Yeni Etkinlik' dialog. Studio1 has gallery module access. The three native selects (sg-event-date-day/-month/-year) are rendered as <SELECT> elements with Turkish month labels (Ocak..Aralık) and year range 2025-2030. All three dropdowns are clickable and update state inside the Radix Dialog. Selected 15 / Haziran (6) / 2026, filled 'Test Düğün' + 'Ali Veli', clicked 'Oluştur'. POST /api/studio/gallery/events returned 200 with event_date="2026-06-15" exactly as chosen. Success toast 'Etkinlik oluşturuldu' displayed. New event card 'Test Düğün / Ali Veli' appeared in the grid (event count went 5 -> 6). No console errors related to the flow (only pre-existing 401 on some unrelated /api resource during initial load).
test_credentials: studio1@test.com / Test1234 (has gallery access, admin fallback not needed)
seed_data_creation: Created a 'Test Düğün' gallery event with client 'Ali Veli' and date 2026-06-15 via the UI as part of verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Date picker bug fix confirmed. DateSelects component in StudioGallery.jsx works correctly inside the Dialog. Event creation posts YYYY-MM-DD to /api/studio/gallery/events and receives 200. No further action needed for this bug.
rca of the issue: Original Radix Popover-based calendar (TrDatePicker) lost pointer/focus inside Radix Dialog. Replaced with three native <select> dropdowns (DateSelects) that assemble YYYY-MM-DD. Native selects don't rely on portal/pointer capture, so they work inside modal contexts. Verified end-to-end.
